description: VectorStore selection sidebar lists all available Spring AI VectorStore beans
steps: Navigate to /rag
Verify sidebar renders a list of available vectorstores (simpleVectorStore, pgVectorStore, redisVectorStore)
Click on a vectorstore entry
Verify the main content area updates without full page reload
Verify the selected store is visually highlighted in the sidebar

description: Document list displays all documents ingested in the selected vectorstore
steps: Select a vectorstore from the sidebar
Navigate to the 'Documentos' tab
Verify a table renders with columns: ID, filename, estimated size, ingestion date
Verify documents are loaded via HTMX without full page reload
Verify pagination controls appear when document count exceeds page size

description: File upload form adds a TXT or MD document to the selected RAG
steps: Select a vectorstore from the sidebar
Navigate to the 'Adicionar' tab
Upload a .txt file using the drag-and-drop or file picker
Verify a progress indicator is shown during processing
Verify success feedback is displayed after upload completes
Verify the document appears in the document list tab

description: File upload supports PDF documents with automatic text extraction
steps: Select a vectorstore from the sidebar
Navigate to the 'Adicionar' tab
Upload a .pdf file
Verify the file is accepted and processed
Verify success feedback is shown with chunk count
Verify document appears in the document list

description: GitHub repository import ingests documents from a public repository
steps: Select a vectorstore from the sidebar
Navigate to the 'Adicionar' tab
Fill in GitHub repository URL (e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo)
Set branch to 'main' and optionally a subdirectory path
Set file extension filter (e.g. *.md)
Click 'Importar'
Verify progress or loading indicator is shown
Verify summary feedback shows files processed and chunks created
Verify documents appear in the document list

description: GitHub import supports optional personal access token for private repositories
steps: Navigate to the GitHub import form
Expand the 'Configurações Avançadas' section
Enter a GitHub Personal Access Token
Enter a private repository URL
Submit the import form
Verify documents are imported successfully

description: Single document deletion removes the document from the vectorstore
steps: Select a vectorstore with at least one document
Navigate to the 'Documentos' tab
Click the delete icon on a specific document row
Verify a confirmation prompt or modal appears
Confirm the deletion
Verify the document is removed from the list without full page reload
Verify success feedback is displayed

description: Bulk document deletion removes multiple selected documents from the vectorstore
steps: Select a vectorstore with multiple documents
Navigate to the 'Documentos' tab
Select multiple documents using checkboxes
Verify the 'Remover Selecionados' button becomes active showing count
Click 'Remover Selecionados'
Verify confirmation modal shows the count of documents to be deleted
Confirm the deletion
Verify all selected documents are removed from the list
Verify unselected documents remain

description: Select-all checkbox in document table selects or deselects all documents
steps: Navigate to the document list of a vectorstore with multiple documents
Click the select-all checkbox in the table header
Verify all document row checkboxes become checked
Click the select-all checkbox again
Verify all document row checkboxes become unchecked

description: Keyword search returns relevant documents ranked by similarity score
steps: Select a vectorstore with ingested documents
Navigate to the 'Buscar' tab
Type a keyword or phrase in the search field
Verify results appear automatically after 500ms debounce
Verify results show document excerpt, similarity score, and metadata
Verify results are ordered by descending similarity score

description: Advanced search controls allow filtering by topK and similarity threshold
steps: Navigate to the 'Buscar' tab
Expand the 'Filtros Avançados' section
Change the 'Número de resultados (topK)' slider to 3
Change the 'Threshold de Similaridade' to 0.8
Enter a search query
Verify results return at most 3 items
Verify all results have similarity score >= 0.8

description: Advanced search supports metadata key/value filter expressions
steps: Navigate to the 'Buscar' tab
Expand the 'Filtros Avançados' section
Add a metadata filter with key 'filename' and value 'faq.txt'
Enter a search query
Verify results only contain documents with matching metadata

description: All RAG management interactions use HTMX and do not cause full page reloads
steps: Open browser devtools Network tab
Perform vectorstore selection
Perform document upload
Perform document deletion
Perform a search query
Verify no full HTML document (200 with full <html>) responses in network tab for these actions
Verify only HTML fragment responses are returned by HTMX endpoints

description: Upload form validates file type and displays error for unsupported formats
steps: Navigate to the 'Adicionar' tab
Attempt to upload a .exe or .zip file
Verify an inline error message is displayed
Verify the file is not processed or added to the vectorstore

description: GitHub import form validates URL format before submission
steps: Navigate to the GitHub import form
Enter an invalid URL (e.g. 'not-a-url')
Click 'Importar'
Verify inline validation error is displayed
Verify no network request is made to the backend import endpoint
